added_lines: for the feast of all saints sunday 1st november, 2026 saturday 31st october 6.30 p.m. vigil mass sunday 1st november 10.00 a.m. and 12 noon madonna del boeme of murillo by amelia curran the author martina devlin has written a book called “glorious monsters ”. the book is set in the city of rome in 1819. it is written through the eye of amelia curran the irish artist, who painted the portrait of the picture madonna del boeme of murillo. this picture is now in our church st. john the baptist, church blackrock. if you wish to read more about amelia’s life and the stories and characters surrounding the picture, please read the book “glorious monsters” by martina devlin. blackrock
